summary.text: The summary of the polio eradication strategic plan (in French), stating that by end-2003 polio remained in only six countries, nearly five million children had been spared paralysis and vitamin A distribution had averted 1.25 million child deaths. Footnotes list the remaining endemic countries and note that the plan replaces the 2001–2005 plan.

summary.text: Describes the strategic approach to interrupting wild poliovirus transmission (in French), combining routine and supplementary immunization with high-quality surveillance. It sets out supplementary immunization plans and synchronized campaigns across countries and regions.
